newsitem.title: USA: Dow posts second largest daily gain in history.
newsitem.headline: Dow posts second largest daily gain in history.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average soared Tuesday to post its second largest daily gain ever as investors rushed to the relative safety of big-name companies.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow ended up 173.38 points, or 2.60 percent, at 6,833.59. In the broader market, advancing issues beat declines 15-9 on active volume of 501 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
